Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of Stillwater, a Peabody and Emmy Award-winning series about mindfulness. Watch the trailer below:

Stillwater returns on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of Stillwater, with all five episodes dropping on the same day on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of Stillwater will add more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday practices," continuing the show's mission of helping children and families find inner calm.

Stillwater originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020 and has won the Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Preschool Animated Program, as well as the Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth Programming category.
